scripts.build: cd client && npm install && CI=false npm run build
scripts.test:load-report: artillery run load-test.yml --output test-results.json && artillery report test-results.json
scripts.start:all: concurrently "cd server && npm start" "cd client && npm start"
scripts.test:performance: npm run test:lighthouse && npm run test:load-report
scripts.test:full-performance: npm run test:requirements && npm run test:lighthouse
